nodes.label: User List Icon
nodes.description: An orange/coral-colored icon depicting a document or list with three user/person silhouettes on the left side and horizontal text lines on the right, representing a user roster, member list, or people directory. Used as a UI icon for user management or member listing features.
nodes.visual_concept: user list, member roster, people directory, contact list
nodes.style: flat icon, outlined document shape with filled user avatars and text line placeholders
